jobs.occupation: Senior data engineer for US Product Team
jobs.description:
Vi vil løbende vurdere ansøgninger, så send din ansøgning hurtigst muligt.

Om stillingen

Som Senior Data Engineer i vores US Product Team bliver du en nøglefigur i udviklingen af vores datainfrastruktur og -løsninger. Du vil arbejde tæt sammen med vores produkt- og trading-team for at sikre, at vi har de rette data og værktøjer til at drive vores forretningsudvikling fremad.

Dine opgaver

• Design, udvikling og vedligeholdelse af robuste data pipelines og arkitekturer.

• Samarbejde med stakeholders for at forstå forretningskrav og oversætte dem til tekniske løsninger.

• Optimering af eksisterende dataprocesser for at øge effektivitet og pålidelighed.

• Sikring af datakvalitet og -integritet på tværs af vores systemer.

• Mentoring og sparring med mindre erfarne kolleger i teamet.

Om dig

• Du har en relevant uddannelse inden for datalogi, softwareudvikling eller lignende.

• Du har flere års erfaring med data engineering, gerne med fokus på store datamængder og cloud-løsninger.

• Du er fortrolig med moderne data-teknologier som f.eks. Python, SQL, Apache Spark, Kafka eller lignende.

• Du har erfaring med cloud-platforme som AWS, Azure eller GCP.

• Du er en selvstændig problemløser, der trives i et dynamisk og tværfagligt miljø.

• Du har gode kommunikative evner på både dansk og engelsk.

Vi tilbyder

• Et spændende og udfordrende job i en international virksomhed med højt til loftet.

• Mulighed for at påvirke og forme vores data-strategi og -arkitektur.

• Et godt kollegialt miljø med fokus på faglig udvikling og personlig vækst.

• Konkurrencedygtige løn- og ansættelsesvilkår.

Sådan søger du

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Steen Lykke Jeppesen, Senior manager, Head of Short-Term Trading Technology, på telefon [nummer mangler i kilde].

Send din ansøgning og dit CV via linket nedenfor. Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig.

Apply for job

Om Danske Commodities

Danske Commodities er en førende aktør inden for handel og rådgivning i energimarkedet. Vi har kontorer i flere lande og en stærk tilstedeværelse i Norden, Europa og USA. Vores mål er at levere innovative løsninger og værdi til vores kunder og aktionærer.

**Join Dalux and design products that transform the construction industry

**As a Product Designer at Dalux, you'll join a team of 12 designers creating intuitive solutions for one of the world's largest, and least digitalised industries.

You'll be part of cross-functional product teams, collaborating with Product Management and Engineering throughout the product lifecycle, from discovery to delivery. Through user research, prototyping, and iterative design, you'll turn complex workflows into intuitive experiences used by construction professionals around the world.

Over the past two years, we've invested significantly in growing our design practice. We've built a strong design community, but we're still evolving. This means you'll have the opportunity to influence not only the products we build, but also how design is embedded across our organisation.

**In this role, you will

**

• Collaborate with Product Managers and developers to discover opportunities and shape product direction

• Conduct user research, interviews, and usability testing to understand user needs and validate ideas

• Design user flows, wireframes, prototypes, and polished user interfaces using Figma and AI tools throughout the design process

• Use Dalux's design system to create consistent experiences across our products and contribute to its continued evolution

• Work closely with developers to bring your designs to life and continuously improve the user experience

**Your Background

**We're looking for someone who enjoys turning complex problems into simple, intuitive user experiences. Ideally, you have:

• At least 3 years of experience designing complex software products, preferably within SaaS

• A relevant university degree (Bachelor's or Master’s level)

• Experience with user research and end-to-end product design

• Confidence collaborating closely with Product Managers and developers in cross-functional teams

• A curious, analytical, and detail-oriented mindset with the ability to quickly understand technical systems, industry-specific workflows, and new technologies such as AI

• Fluency in English and proficiency in at least one of the following languages: Danish, German, French, Spanish, or Italian

**What To Expect As a Daluxian

**At Dalux, you'll join an international product organisation where collaboration, trust, and continuous learning are part of everyday work. We offer:

• A central Copenhagen office with a healthy work-life balance, no overtime culture, and no dress code

• Flat hierarchies, short decision-making paths, and the freedom to influence both products and ways of working

• A collaborative design team that values knowledge sharing, feedback, and professional development

• An active social environment with monthly events and employee clubs

• Attractive benefits including health insurance, lunch, fitness facilities, coffee, fruit, and free parking

**Next Steps

**If you're excited about designing products that solve real-world problems and help shape the future of construction technology, we'd love to hear from you. Submit your CV, application, and portfolio today. If you have any questions about the role, please don't hesitate to contact Line Hassenkam Klinge.

**About Dalux

**Founded in 2005, Dalux develops software that digitises the construction industry. Today, we're more than 900 colleagues across 30+ countries, while all product development takes place at our headquarters in Copenhagen.

Using technologies such as cloud computing, 3D visualisation, computer vision, drones, and AI, we create software that supports the entire lifecycle of a building, from design and construction to operation and maintenance, helping our customers save time, reduce waste, and build smarter.

**Application deadline:

**As soon as possible

What if developers could spend less time navigating complexity and more time building great technology?

Join Pandora as our Lead Engineer, Developer Experience and help shape how engineering teams build, deliver and operate software at scale.

You will lead the implementation and evolution of our Developer Experience platform and Developer Portal strategy, using Port.io as the foundation for a simpler, more connected and increasingly self-service engineering environment.

This is an opportunity to influence Developer Experience across a global technology organisation. You will help reduce friction throughout the software development lifecycle, improve visibility and ownership of software assets, and create practical standards and capabilities that enable engineering teams to move faster and with greater confidence.

**Help Write Our Next Chapter

**As a technical leader within our DevOps & Operational Excellence team, you will:

• Lead the implementation, configuration and continued development of Pandora’s Developer Portal, built on Port.io.

• Own the architecture of our software catalogue, including metadata, service ownership and portal governance.

• Design engineering scorecards covering operational readiness, security, reliability, documentation and architecture standards.

• Establish and maintain Golden Paths that simplify and standardise software delivery.

• Drive adoption of self-service capabilities across development, deployment, observability and operational excellence.

• Integrate Port.io with platforms including GitHub, Azure DevOps, ServiceNow, Datadog, Splunk, Azure and Kubernetes.

• Build greater visibility into engineering health, service quality and operational readiness.

• Use DORA metrics, flow metrics and Developer Experience frameworks to support measurable improvements.

• Identify friction across the software development lifecycle and turn this into focused improvement initiatives.

• Influence engineering leaders and teams to adopt shared platform standards and self-service ways of working.

• Facilitate communities of practice and knowledge sharing across engineering teams.

• Evaluate emerging developments across Developer Experience, Internal Developer Platforms and Platform Engineering.

**What Makes You Shine

**You are passionate about improving the day-to-day experience of engineers and understand that great Developer Experience is about more than tooling. It brings together thoughtful platform design, automation, clear ownership, effective governance and a deep understanding of how developers work.

**We would love to hear from you if you bring:

**

• 8+ years of relevant experience across Developer Experience, Platform Engineering, Internal Developer Platforms or a closely related engineering discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and professional experience will also be considered.

• Experience implementing or evolving a developer portal, software catalogue or comparable self-service engineering platform.

• Knowledge of software catalogue architecture, service ownership and engineering governance.

• Experience designing Golden Paths, engineering scorecards or reusable self-service capabilities.

• A strong understanding of CI/CD, cloud platforms, Kubernetes and Infrastructure as Code.

• Experience integrating engineering tools and platforms such as GitHub, Azure DevOps, Azure, ServiceNow or observability solutions.

• Familiarity with DORA metrics, flow metrics or other approaches to measuring engineering effectiveness.

• Professional fluency in English.

• Experience with Port.io would be particularly valuable. However, we are also interested in people who have built relevant experience through comparable developer portals, Internal Developer Platforms or service catalogue technologies.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this opportunity excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

**Crafting What’s Next, Together

**You will join Pandora’s DevOps & Operational Excellence team within Digital & Technology and report to the Director of DevOps & Operational Excellence.

Your work will connect you with colleagues across Platform Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Cyber Security, Software Engineering, Product Engineering, Service Management and Cloud Platforms. You will have the opportunity to shape solutions across organisational boundaries and help create a more consistent, productive and developer-centred engineering environment.

This role is a Lead Engineer, individual contributor role.

**The Impact You Will Make

**Your impact will be visible through the adoption of the Developer Portal and Golden Paths, increased use of self-service platform capabilities, broader coverage of the software catalogue and clearer service ownership.

The role will also contribute to reducing developer onboarding time, strengthening engineering standards, improving developer satisfaction and reducing manual governance activities.

**The Additional Sparkle

**You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas. It’s a great base from which to help shape Pandora’s Developer Experience and influence how our engineering teams work globally.

**Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

**If you can see yourself improving how engineers build, deliver and operate technology, while helping Pandora advance its Platform Engineering and Operational Excellence journey, we would love to hear from you.

Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

**Let’s Craft the Incredible

**Pandora is the world’s largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, helping people share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Pandora brings together craftsmanship, innovation and responsible business practices. Join us and bring your expertise, ideas and unique contribution as we continue to craft what comes next

**Job Description Summary

**As a Service Account Leader at GE HealthCare, you will play a key role in growing our service business across Denmark. By building trusted customer relationships and delivering innovative lifecycle solutions, you will help healthcare providers maximize equipment uptime, optimize operational performance, and deliver exceptional patient care.

Working closely with local sales and service teams, you will identify new business opportunities, develop strategic service offerings, and drive sustainable growth across our Imaging, Ultrasound, and Patient Care Solutions portfolio. The role combines commercial leadership, customer engagement, and cross-functional collaboration in a dynamic international environment.

**Responsibilities

****Job Description

**

• Sell point-of-sale service contracts and solutions while protecting margin by communicating value and maintaining pricing discipline.

• Develop and maintain in-depth knowledge of GE HealthCare’s service solutions and relevant competitive offerings.

• Develop account penetration strategies for key target accounts and competitive accounts. Share market intelligence, field concerns, emerging issues, and customer requirements with the wider business.

• Lead customer negotiations and close deals by engaging key buying stakeholders, including technical and biomedical personnel, department heads, and C-suite executives.

• Achieve annual and quarterly revenue targets by maintaining accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts, prioritizing selling time effectively, increasing sales volume, deepening account penetration, and ensuring comprehensive territory coverage.

• Maintain strong after-sales relationships, develop long-term customer partnerships, and identify opportunities that address both immediate and evolving customer needs.

**Qualifications/Requirements

**

• At least one of the following core experiences:

• Consultative sales or marketing experience, including strategic selling and negotiation in a complex sales environment involving multiple decision-makers and influencers.

• Healthcare service experience, preferably in Diagnostic Imaging, Ultrasound, or Patient Care Solutions.

• Experience in one or more customer-facing roles.

• Excellent written and spoken Danish and English language skills.

• Willingness to travel within the assigned geographic region.

**Desired Skills

**

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• Previous Healthcare sales experience.

• Robust interpersonal skills, with demonstrated ability to work independently as well as with a team.

• Strong written and verbal communication and clear thinking skills with the ability to synthesize complex issues into simple messages.

• Solid process orientation, demonstrated resource management and allocation experience, and the ability to perform multiple tasks simultaneously.

• Ability to energize, develop, and build rapport at all levels within an organization.

• Experience interfacing with both internal team members and external customers as a part of a solution-based sales process.

**Inclusion and Diversity

**GE HealthCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer where inclusion matters. Employment decisions are made without regard to race, color, religion, national or ethnic origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.

**Behaviours

**We expect all employees to live and breathe our behaviors: to act with humility and build trust; lead with transparency; deliver with focus, and drive ownership – always with unyielding integrity.

**Total Rewards

**Our total rewards are designed to unlock your ambition by giving you the boost and flexibility you need to turn your ideas into world-changing realities. Our salary and benefits are everything you’d expect from an organization with global strength and scale, and you’ll be surrounded by career opportunities in a culture that fosters care, collaboration, and support.

A Snapshot of Your Day

As a software developer in our turbine software team, you will play a key role in developing the embedded software that controls wind turbines. Your day will involve close collaboration with team members and stakeholders from around the world, working through the full software development lifecycle—from requirements clarification and implementation to testing and maintenance. You’ll contribute to innovative projects, participate in agile SCRUM teams, and help ensure our solutions are robust, secure, and high-performing. With a flexible work environment, you’ll have the opportunity to balance independent tasks with teamwork, both in the office and remotely.

How You’ll Make an Impact

• Develop and maintain control software in C++ for Linux-based embedded systems, ensuring reliable operation of wind turbines.

• Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to clarify requirements and deliver high-quality software solutions.

• Conduct comprehensive software testing, including unit, integration, and acceptance tests, employing strong CI/CD practices and AI-assisted programming.

• Refactor and enhance existing code to maintain fleet performance and participate in innovation initiatives such as code camps and ideation events.

• Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by following agile development principles within a SCRUM and SAFe environment.

What You Bring

• Academic degree in IT, Software, Electronics, Computer Science, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field, combined with 5+ years of experience in C/C++ software development.

• Proficiency in object-oriented programming, software testing, continuous integration, embedded control mechanisms, and middleware development for Linux-based x86 and ARM platforms, including Linux system hardening for cyber-security.

• A keen interest in control of mechanical areas such as aerodynamics, mechanics, hydraulics, and power electronics, with a passion for integrating hardware and software into safe, high-quality solutions.

• Experience working with real-time protocols (e.g., ProfiNet), version control systems (Git), task management tools (Jira), and agile development methodologies such as SCRUM and SAFe.

• Strong communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills, combined with a structured and proactive approach, an ownership mindset, and a passion for delivering high-quality software solutions in the renewable energy sector.

About the Team

You’ll join a diverse and innovative team dedicated to advancing renewable energy through pioneering software solutions. We value collaboration, creativity, and continuous learning, working together in an agile environment to drive the success of our wind turbine projects. Our team thrives on mutual support, open communication, and a shared commitment to making a positive impact on the world.

Who is Siemens Gamesa?

Siemens Gamesa is part of Siemens Energy, a global leader in energy technology with a rich legacy of innovation spanning over 150 years. Together, we are committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. As a leading player in the wind industry and manufacturer of wind turbines, we are passionate about driving the energy transition and providing innovative solutions that meet the growing energy demand of the global community. At Siemens Gamesa, we are constantly seeking individuals to join our team and support our focus on energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Gamesa: https://www.siemens-energy.com/global/en/home/careers/working-with-us.html

Our Commitment to Diversity

Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by multiple nationalities. We celebrate character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.

Rewards/Benefits

• Opportunities to work with a global team

• Medical benefits

• Remote/Flexible work

• Paid holidays and parental leave

• Employer-funded pension

• Subsidised lunch and more

**Job Description

**If you want to take a leading role in shaping the IRB model landscape at a major Nordic bank, this is your opportunity. As Chief Data Scientist in our Risk Modelling and Analytics department, you will own complex modelling topics and help colleagues grow. You will work on models that matter, directly contributing to how Danske Bank manages credit risk.

**What you will be doing:

**You will join the LGD and CF development team within Risk Modelling and Analytics, a collaborative group that works across the full model development lifecycle. The team covers everything from understanding regulatory and business requirements and designing methodologies, through data sourcing and analysis, to building robust model solutions and supporting implementation, validation, and ongoing performance assessment. You will work closely with colleagues in Risk Management, Validation, IT and data teams, and the wider business, contributing to a culture where technical depth and clear thinking go hand in hand.

**More specifically, you will:

**

• Lead end-to-end development of IRB LGD and CF models, from data exploration to documentation.

• Take ownership of complex modelling challenges and contribute to key methodological decisions.

• Build robust, explainable, and regulatory-compliant models using statistical and machine learning techniques.

• Act as a technical sparring partner, sharing knowledge and supporting other Data Scientists.

• Contribute to regulatory dialogue and improve IRB modelling standards and practices.

**About you:

**

• Around five or more years of experience in data science, credit risk, or IRB model development.

• Strong experience in IRB model development, ideally including LGD and/or CF models.

• Skilled in writing clean, modular Python and SQL with good software engineering habits.

• Clear communicator, able to translate technical and mathematical concepts for diverse audiences.

• Collaborative and self-directed, comfortable taking ownership and sharing knowledge.

If you are curious about tools such as GitHub Copilot or AI-assisted coding, that is a genuine advantage. We value an open mindset and a willingness to explore smarter ways of working over prior experience with any specific tool.

**We offer:

**The workplace can be in Vilnius, Lithuania or Copenhagen, Denmark. If you are hired in Lithuania, monthly salary range would be from 4320 EUR to 6480 EUR gross (based on your competencies relevant for the job).

Additionally, each Danske Bank employee receives employee benefits package (this one is only valid for Lithuania) which includes:

• Growth opportunities: professional & supportive team, e-learnings, numerous development programs; (incl. professional certificates); 100+ professions for internal mobility opportunities.

• Health & Well-being: a diverse, inclusive, work & life balance work environment; additional health insurance; mental well-being practices; partial psychologist counselling compensation; silence and sleep zones at the office; game rooms.

• Hybrid working conditions: Work from home up to two days a week; home office budget (after the probation period); modern Danske Campus workplace developed with anthropologist for the best employee experience.

• Additional days of leave: for rest, health, volunteering, exams in higher education institutions, and other important activities. Moreover, for seniority with Danske Bank.

• Monetary compensation package: accidents & critical diseases insurance; financial support in case of unfortunate events, travel insurance; IIIrd Pillar Pension Fund contribution.

See all the benefits HERE.

Your job function (position) in the job contract will be AI Science.

**About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Can you keep an overview in a busy operational environment, bring structure to your tasks and make the right priorities when plans change? Do you enjoy working with people, taking responsibility and finding solutions?

Blue Water Shipping is looking for a dedicated Port Agent to join our Cruise & Port Agency team in Greve. As a Port Agent, you will become part of our 24/7 duty setup, acting as the link between our customers, vessels, ports, authorities, suppliers and other stakeholders. Flexibility is important part of the position, and it requires working outside normal office hours in connection with vessel operations, including early mornings, evenings, nights and weekends.

**About The Role

**As part of the team, you will be involved in planning, coordinating and following vessel calls from the initial preparations until the vessel has departed again. The role combines office-based planning and administration with hands-on operational work at vessels and terminals. You will work with a broad variety of vessels, including cruise ships, cargo vessels and navy vessels calling at Danish ports. The role is primarily based in Greve, but occasional work in Copenhagen is required, as Copenhagen is a major part of the daily operation.

Following your training and as your experience develops, you will take responsibility for coordinating your own vessel calls and daily operations, always with experienced colleagues and managers available for support and sparring. You will act as the customer’s local representative and help ensure that each port call is handled safely, professionally and according to the agreed operational plan.

**Your primary responsibilities will include:

**

• Coordination and handling of vessel port calls

• Planning and coordination of daily port operations

• Daily communication with vessels, customers, ports, authorities and suppliers

• Attendance of vessels and operations at the pier when required

• Handling vessel clearances and relevant documentation

• Coordination of crew changes, transportation and other crew-related services

• Arranging services, supplies, spare parts and other vessel requirements

• Customer invoicing and administrative follow-up

• Handling changing operational requirements and finding solutions when plans change

• Supporting port calls in other Danish ports when required

**Who Are You

**Previous experience in ship agency, shipping or a similar operational role is an advantage, but not a requirement. We are also open to candidates with transferable experience from other service-oriented or operational environments. Most importantly, you are reliable, service-minded, proactive and motivated to learn.

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership and follows tasks through

• Is proactive, solution-oriented and adaptable

• Remains calm and structured under pressure

• Communicates confidently and professionally with different stakeholders

• Works well both independently and as part of a team

• Enjoys a fast-paced, international environment

• Has an interest in shipping, port operations and the maritime industry

You should have strong written and spoken English skills, be comfortable with MS Office and new IT systems, hold a valid Category B driving licence, and be able to travel within Denmark and occasionally abroad.

**What We Offer

**At Blue Water Shipping, you will become part of an informal working environment with experienced colleagues and a strong focus on cooperation, responsibility and professional development.

You will have the opportunity to learn the port agency profession through hands-on experience and daily sparring with colleagues and managers.

We offer:

• A varied working day with responsibility and operational challenges

• Hands-on experience within the international shipping and cruise industries

• Training and continuous professional development

• The opportunity to gradually take responsibility for your own vessel calls and customers

• Close cooperation with experienced colleagues across Blue Water Shipping

• Exposure to international customers, vessels, ports and maritime professionals

• A strong community where cooperation, commitment and team spirit are important

**Contact

**If you have any questions about the position, you are welcome to contact Pernille Marcussen, Manager, Cruise & Port Agency, at +45 42124613 or pmar@bws.dk.

Apply as soon as possible, as we review and interview on an ongoing basis.

What we do – Together we create solutions

We are a proud family-owned company, founded in Denmark in 1972, and a global provider of all logistics services within modern supply chain management. Our value foundation is still thriving today, driven by a pronounced entrepreneurial spirit and sound business practices. Therefore, our employees are offered a strong professional environment with great freedom, ensuring our customers the best service. Blue Water Shipping is represented by more than 2,700 employees worldwide, combining a strong global network with local expertise, enabling us to offer complete and tailored solutions for any shipping need anywhere in the world.

****Job Description:

****Are you ready to drive change, foster a culture of commercial excellence, and lead strategic transformation projects? As the Regional Perfo & Transformation Manager at Satair, you will act as the primary representative for the Commercial Process, Performance & Transformation (ASCX) team in your region. You will bridge the gap between regional teams and the central ASCX pillars of processes, performance, data analytics, and automation to support Satair's commercial objectives. We are looking for a structured, results-oriented leader who can influence without authority and advocate for the region's needs within a complex, shared Airbus ecosystem.

**What The Job Is

**You will report to the Head of Commercial Data Analytics (HO ASCXY) and integrate into a multi-disciplinary team spread across the globe. In this role, you will serve as the regional node for a centralized cross-functional team, meaning you will not have direct reports but will lead by influence across regional commercial teams, account directors, and operations.

Your main responsibilities:

• Regional Commercial Project Portfolio Leadership: Accountable for the regional commercial project portfolio's financial impact and performance metrics, leading transformation projects using LBIP and Agile methodologies.

• Regional AOS Roadmap Execution: Take accountability for the successful implementation of the AOS (Airbus Operating System) regional roadmap in alignment with ASCX and the Regional Managing Director.

• Regional Representation & Connectivity: Act as a critical connector between regional teams and ASCX, representing ASCX in the Regional Customer Satisfaction Review Board (R-CSRB) and other commercial forums.

• Culture & Continuous Improvement: Proactively drive a culture of creativity, commercial excellence, and continuous improvement by identifying and addressing systemic "irritants".

Travel days to be expected are approximately 30% (domestic and international).

**How You Will Contribute To The Team

**We are looking for a proactive professional with an excellent problem-solving mindset and an ability to translate data into actionable insights. You must possess a keen understanding of business issues, key stakeholders, and external dynamics which inform priority setting.

You must hold a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related field, accompanied by 5-10 years of proven experience leading cross-functional, regional, and global continuous improvement and transformation projects in a complex setting. A strong understanding of aviation aftermarket commercial operations is highly preferred, as are additional certifications in process improvement methodologies (e.g., Six Sigma, Lean). You will thrive in this role if you possess a high degree of agility in learning, exceptional communication and presentation abilities, and a proactive "can-do attitude". Because you will be networking globally, an excellent command of both written and spoken English is required, while proficiency in a secondary language relevant to the assigned region is preferred.

**What does your next challenge look like?

**At SATAIR, we believe in sustainable aviation that allows people to travel and connect across the globe.

We are on a mission to provide world class material solutions that keep aircraft flying and extend their lifespan.

In Satair, you can challenge the status quo, pioneer new ways of working, and generate real value for airlines and suppliers worldwide.

Being part of the Airbus family gives us the opportunity to live a global mindset, working in international and diverse teams and collaborating across functions, sites and cultures.

If you want to work as one team embracing a can-do attitude in a demanding environment, then we offer a great place to explore, learn, and grow, making an impact on aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company!

**About SATAIR

**Satair is an Airbus Services company offering first-class material management solutions in the aviation aftermarket industry. We take pride in delivering an excellent customer experience around the clock, driving innovation, and contributing to aviation’s digital and sustainable transformation.

With our global functional organisation spanning 12 sites and locations worldwide, and a team of over 2,000 people supporting a $3.9 billion turnover, you will be part of a truly global company that continues to grow year after year.

Welcome to the Satair family!

If you want to know more about our business, have a closer look at our website www.SATAIR.com or check out our SATAIR Youtube Channel at www.youtube.com/sataircompany !

**What do we offer at SATAIR?

**At SATAIR, you will find much more than a job - we offer you the possibility of growing both your personal and professional capacities in a fun, supportive and informal working environment, where you will be encouraged to engage, share knowledge and ideas.

SATAIR is committed to achieving workforce diversity and creating an inclusive working environment. We love to bring in people with different backgrounds and experiences as we believe it enhances our performance immensely!

Here is a selection of some of the benefits we offer our employees in Copenhagen:

Financial Benefits: Competitive salary, Employee Stock Ownership Program, Success sharing, Health insurance, Group accident insurance, Employee discounts to local businesses

Employee Health and Wellbeing: On-site gym, App-based health & wellbeing platform, Amazing canteen at a subsided price, Massage scheme

Learning and Development: Airbus Leadership University, Large number of e-learning and training offers for personal and professional development, Promotion of professional development (e.g. postgraduate studies, technician training), Possibility of mentoring, Gain international experience

Work-life blend and life phase support: Possibility to work remotely, 4 care days, Senior days, Working from home policy (2 days remote per week)

**Come on board and join us at Satair, an Airbus Services Company

**Please send us your application as soon as possible to get the opportunity to become part of an exceptional global team!

We welcome all applications irrespective of social and cultural background, age, gender, disability, sexual orientation or religious belief.

When applying for the position, you accept our data privacy statement: http://www.SATAIR.com/privacy

This job requires an awareness of any potential compliance risks and a commitment to act with integrity, as the foundation for the Company’s success, reputation and sustainable growth.

**Job Requisition ID #

**26WD99977

**Business Consultant - AECO Technical Advisory

****Position Overview

**Autodesk Consulting is looking for a Business Consultant to join our Northern Europe team. This remote role supports strategic customers across the region.

This is a senior individual contributor role combining business consulting, AECO industry expertise and executive advisory. You’ll work with some of Autodesk’s largest customers to shape transformation strategies, define target operating models, and develop business cases and roadmaps that deliver measurable business outcomes.

You’ll advise senior leaders, structure complex business challenges and lead strategic advisory engagements from discovery through executive decision-making. While you won’t configure or implement solutions, you’ll understand how Autodesk and complementary technologies fit within customers’ broader business and technology ecosystems, partnering with technical specialists to turn strategy into actionable delivery plans.

jobs.occupation: Data Portfolio Analyst for Markets Data Office
jobs.description:
Bring your banking and data experience into our newly established Markets Data Office. Join us and work with critical data in Markets as part of a team that is being built right now. Join us in building a new data capability in Markets

About the job

At Saxo, we are building the Markets Data Office as part of our Data Governance Programme. The team is organised across four domain areas: Products, Operations, Counterparty Risk and Market Risk. Together, these areas reflect how critical data is used across Markets.

We are a newly established team and still in our build phase. Our first permanent colleagues joined in September 2026. Today, we are eight people, and we are growing to twelve.

As the team grows, we are creating the foundations for how we work, including frameworks, standards, tooling and governance practices. At the same time, we are already delivering on ongoing data initiatives across Markets.

This is an opportunity to join early, influence how we work and make a real impact on how data is governed at scale.

What you will do

As a Data Portfolio Analyst, you will take ownership of data governance activities within one of our four domain areas. You will work closely with business stakeholders, data owners, data stewards and technology teams to improve how critical data is defined, monitored and controlled.

Depending on your domain, you could work with instrument reference data, market data, price data, custody information, election data, trades, positions, counterparty risk or model data.

You will be part of one Markets Data Office with shared standards, tooling and governance practices, while also helping to define and improve these as the team develops.

Your responsibilities will include

• Taking ownership of ongoing data governance activities within your domain and driving them forward

• Identifying and documenting Critical Data Attributes (CDAs) by reviewing data attributes with stakeholders, assessing which are critical for Saxo and driving the governance of Critical Data Elements (CDEs)

• Analysing data together with data owners to assess quality, identify issues and lead root cause investigations

• Defining and maintaining data definitions, rules, thresholds and documentation used in monitoring and control activities

• Monitoring data quality outputs, tracking remediation and escalating when issues are not being resolved

• Building strong working relationships with data owners, data stewards and stakeholders across business and technology

• Helping shape the frameworks, standards and ways of working for the Markets Data Office

A key part of your role will be making sure documentation is clear, structured and easy to maintain, helping create transparency and consistency across the organisation.

Who you are

You bring:

• Some years of experience from the banking sector, which is a requirement for this position

• Experience in data analysis, data quality, data governance or a related field

• The ability to understand data in the context of business processes and explain your findings clearly to both business and technical audiences

• The ability to produce clear and structured documentation

• Hands on experience with SQL. Experience with Python is an advantage

• Experience using AI and other technology tools to automate tasks and find smarter ways of working

It would be a clear advantage if you have

• Experience from Markets functions such as trading, market or counterparty risk, investment products or operations, including an understanding of how a trade moves from front to back

• Experience with data governance in financial services, for example CDEs, data ownership, data profiling, data controls, data lineage or BCBS 239

• Experience with Databricks, Great Expectations, OpenMetadata or similar data platforms and data quality tools

We are looking for someone who:

• Takes ownership. You move your work forward, follow through and take initiative.

• Collaborates naturally. You build trust with business stakeholders, technology teams and colleagues across different domain areas.

• Uses technology naturally. You use technology to analyse, automate, document and find more effective ways of working.

• Is comfortable working in an evolving environment. You can manage changing priorities, bring structure to areas that are still developing and help shape solutions as the team grows.

• Is structured and curious. You have a strong analytical mindset, pay attention to detail and enjoy understanding how things work.

What we offer

• The opportunity to help build a new data function and its foundations from the ground up

• Real ownership and influence on how critical data is governed across Markets

• Exposure to key business domains and critical data flows

• The opportunity to work closely with experienced colleagues across Markets, data and technology

• A role that can develop alongside a growing team

You will join the Markets Data Office at an early stage of its journey, giving you the opportunity to take on new challenges, grow your responsibility and influence how critical data is managed across Markets.

We get curious people invested in the world

jobs.occupation: Sr. Director, Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME
jobs.description:
Are you ready to lead world-class expertise at the front of differentiating peptide and protein drug discovery? Do you want to impact the drug discovery strategy that helps new candidates move faster, more reliably and with stronger scientific confidence towards first human dose?

If so, this is a unique opportunity to advance molecular expression, bioanalysis and ADME science, accelerate drug innovation for people living with serious chronic diseases, and champion technological innovation and collaboration across boundaries to deliver exceptional performance across discovery and development.

**The Position

**As Sr. Director for Expression Engineering, Bioanalysis & ADME, you will lead two centres of excellence and set the direction for the area that enables novel peptide and protein candidates to move quickly and reliably towards first human dose (FHD). Your leadership will enhance molecular expression, PK and ADME science, safeguard critical timelines and strengthen the competitiveness of the discovery portfolio.

You will provide senior leadership for the Centre for Expression Engineering and the Centre for Bioanalysis & ADME, shaping strategy and delivery across the area. You will partner closely with Research Centres of Excellence (RCE), Therapeutic Discovery, Chemistry Manufacturing and Control (CMC), Global Research, Global Manufacturing & Supply (GMS), CROs and academic and biotech collaborators to keep projects progressing with clarity, quality and speed.

You will lead a team of Department Managers and Scientific Directors and, together with them, guide a high-performing, purpose-driven team of around 80 colleagues in total. As a member of the RCE leadership team, you will help move decisions forward and shaping the culture, represent the area in steering committees and sponsor initiatives that improve business outcomes and collaboration.

Location: Måløv, Denmark.

**What You’ll Do

**You will:

• Set and implement the strategic and operational direction for EEBA so new lead drug candidates enter FHD with competitive, de-risked molecular expression, PK and ADME profiles.

• Oversee core deliverables in molecular microbial expression, bioanalysis, PK and ADME for the protein and peptide research portfolio and cross-area strategic projects.

• Own operational efficiency and capacity management, prioritising the FHD critical path activities and aligning mitigations with key stakeholders.

• Lead cross-functional collaboration across Research, CMC/GMS and external partners, acting as a key liaison to keep projects progressing.

• Ensure compliance with regulatory and ethical standards and support the digital strategy through robust data management and AI applications.

• Drive the team to set benchmark for world-class expertise and operational excellence, building and sustaining the capabilities needed to deliver on portfolio ambitions and strategic priorities.

• Inspire and empower department managers and teams through visionary leadership and meaningful mentorship, nurturing talent and creating opportunities for people to grow, thrive and succeed together.

• Build a high-capability, high-performance, challenge-safe and collaborative culture through role-modelling, talent development, succession planning and continuous efficiency improvements.

• Identify and sponsor cross-organisational initiatives that improve business outcomes, collaboration and research impact.

**What You’ll Bring

**This is a senior leadership role in pharmaceutical drug discovery. To succeed, you will bring:

• A PhD in Life Sciences, Pharmacology, Molecular Biology, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of experience in pharmaceutical and/or biotech research, including drug discovery and preclinical development.

• Proven experience leading leaders and managing cross-functional, high-performing research teams and strategic tasks.

• A track record of creating research and business results with impact at a senior level.

• Strong understanding of early drug research, complemented by broader knowledge of the drug development value chain, including clinical development, CMC and manufacturing methods

• Strong collaborative leadership, enterprise and pragmatic mindset and the ability to build partnerships across disciplines and with external partners.

• Decisiveness in complex, uncertain research settings, with clear communication to executives, teams and external partners.

• High ethical standards and a commitment to developing research talent and future leaders.

• Experience applying AI and machine learning to optimise discovery and development.

**What You Can Expect Here

**You will lead outstanding scientific expertise at the front of peptide and protein drug discovery, with the trust to make decisions, set direction and shape how the area works. You will grow through cross-portfolio learning, senior collaboration and the chance to influence strategy across Research & Development. Given the strong scientific expertise already embedded across the organization, direct experience in all technical disciplines is not essential. Instead, we are seeking a leader who excels at leading and motivating people, collaborates across boundaries, and puts enterprise priorities first—with a solid understanding of the drug R&D value chain and significant leadership experience in early drug discovery, biotechnology, or the pharmaceutical industry.

The work moves at pace, combining scientific ambition with a strong performance culture where your contribution is recognised.

You will be part of a collaborative high-performing leadership team where people keep things informal, find creative solutions together and have fun along the way.

**Start now

**Your impact begins today. If you are ready to lead the science that gets competitive new drug candidates to patients faster, apply for the Sr. Director, EEBA role by 8 November 2026. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.

About the job

We are looking for an experienced Video Editor / Photographer to join our in-house creative team for a six-month maternity cover starting in December. The main focus of the role is on video production and editing.

The position is located in our modern Global HQ office in Hellerup. As a Video Editor in the creative team, you will report directly to the Head of Design & Production. You will be responsible for creating video content using in-house resources and agency-produced campaign materials. Your tasks will also include planning and shooting smaller productions, such as financial-analysis talking heads, as well as handling editing, colour grading, sound, and effects through to final delivery. Photography is a secondary part of the role, which will include taking employee portraits and capturing photos of internal events. Major campaign video shoots and still photography are produced with external agencies.

The ideal candidate combines strong editing and storytelling skills with hands-on filming experience. As well as the ability to independently deliver polished video content across various channels.

In this role, you will get the opportunity to work in a hands-on video production role within a global scope. As well as have creative ownership on a variety of assignments. You will work alongside collaborative and highly skilled colleagues in a team that values creativity, ownership, and professional growth.

Responsibilities

• Plan and shoot smaller video productions using in-house resources, such as financial-analysis talking heads and expert interviews, managing cameras, lighting, and sound recording

• Create engaging social media content from in-house footage and agency-produced campaign materials, shaping stories, pacing, and visual flow from initial assembly to final cut

• Complete video post-production, including colour correction and grading, sound editing and mixing, motion graphics, visual effects, and sub-titling

• Edit agency-produced campaign footage into cutdowns and localised versions, adapting aspect ratios, subtitles, graphics, and audio for different channels and markets

• Collaborate with creative, marketing, and compliance stakeholders, incorporating feedback and ensuring brand consistency and production quality

• Manage footage, project files, version control, and final exports, meeting technical specifications and production deadlines

• Photograph employees and internal events, including image selection and retouching

• Coordinate with agencies when supporting major campaign still photography

Your profile

• 5+ years of experience in video production and editing, ideally within a creative agency, production company, or an in-house team

• A strong portfolio demonstrating storytelling, filming, editing, and polished post-production across commercial and social content

• Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro or DaVinci Resolve, with working knowledge of After Effects for motion graphics and visual effects

• Hands-on experience filming smaller productions, including talking heads, with camera operation, lighting, and sound, colour grading, audio finishing, and export workflows

• Ability to deliver video content using in-house resources and agency footage, photography skills for employee portraits and events, including Photoshop or Lightroom

• Strong collaboration skills, fluency in English, and the ability to manage multiple deadlines independently

Are you dedicated to building robust, innovative solutions and motivated to assist in shaping the future of modern banking? Then join our Customer Relationship squad at Danske Bank!

The Customer Relationship squad is responsible for the data and core capabilities of the relationship between a customer and subsidiaries of the Danske Bank Group.

You will work closely with the team and the Product Owner to align with stakeholders and ensure a seamless customer journey, and you will be part of a modernization at the very core of the bank.

We are looking for a Senior Java Software Engineer who enjoys translating business needs into scalable and secure technical solutions. As a squad, we are exploring how AI agents and tools can enhance our development processes, ways of working and the value we deliver. You will help shape this journey by turning promising ideas into practical improvements for the team.

Working closely with your colleagues, you will contribute throughout the development lifecycle – from understanding and refining requirements to implementation, testing, deployment and ongoing support – with efficiency and quality at the heart of everything we do.

You will

• Contribute to solutions throughout the development lifecycle, from design and implementation to deployment and handover to end users.

• Apply your experience to solve complex technical challenges, share knowledge and support colleagues in delivering strong outcomes.

• Ensure high-quality code by applying sound engineering practices and writing automated tests.

• Help us move towards event- and API-focused, cloud-hosted solutions where data consumer self-service is the way forward.

• Operate within a self-organising Scrum team, applying an agile mindset.

• Support, maintain and modernise existing solutions.

• Use AI-assisted development tools to improve productivity and quality and help the team explore and adopt valuable AI solutions.

What we are looking for

• Strong proficiency in Java and its supporting development tools.

• Hands-on experience designing, developing and testing modern software solutions; experience with cloud-native systems is an advantage.

• Professional English communication skills.

• A proactive and collaborative approach to working within and across teams.

• An interest in improving engineering practices and sharing knowledge with colleagues.

• Good understanding of DevOps and CI/CD tools, such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions or Jenkins.

• Hands-on experience using AI as part of software development and a strong focus on identifying, testing and championing AI solutions within the team

• A team-oriented mindset and the ability to communicate clearly about technical decisions and solutions.

Your benefits

As a modern workplace, we offer our employees a canteen, rooftop terrace, regular social and professional events, a very attractive benefits package including health and accident insurance, pension, and many other perks. You will also get 6 weeks of vacation and 5 extra care days annually and be part of a flexible work environment. We expect you to be working minimum 3-4 days per week from our office in Copenhagen.

Sounds interesting?

We will start conducting interviews in November, and application deadline is Monday 9th of November. If you have any questions or would like more information about the role, you are welcome to contact IT Chapter Lead Brian Skou Hansen at briah@danskebank.dk.
